scope: historical-model original-validation subset parameter comparison; not independent test
screening_rule: (p<=8 and (horizontal<=10 or vertical<=10)) or (horizontal<=4 and vertical<=8)
within_validation_group_rule: connected perceptual components; keep lexicographically first
screening_limitations: perceptual matches are conservative candidates, not all confirmed leaks
no embedding or ORB geometry screening was performed on this validation subset
historical training did not preserve an immutable training-time data manifest
original validation selected historical checkpoint; appropriate for exploratory parameter choice, not independent testing

fixed.matching: score-ordered class-aware one-to-one; match all GT before size bins
fixed.size_definition: sqrt(GT area) after longest side scaled to640

timing: each image once per config after same warm-up; rotate config order cyclically by image index; elapsed includes app plotting, excludes shared input read and scoring
reporting: report every configuration; micro F1 as reference ordering plus class/size recall, precision and time; do not automatically change app defaults
